column1: # HIMMEL-3325: origin URL -> forge, one case per line: <expected><TAB><origin url>.
# expected = github | bitbucket | none (neither: forge_detect exits 3).
# Read by BOTH origin matchers so they are checked against the same table and
# The forge is decided by the URL's HOST: the domain itself or a subdomain of
# it, never a substring of the path or of a longer hostname.
# --- true positives: bitbucket.org, every shape git produces
# --- true positives: github.com, every shape git produces
# --- the ticket's false positives: the domain is only a path segment or a hostname suffix
# --- the reverse hole: the github arm used to be tested first on a substring
